pages.title: Zombie Girl
pages.text: §lRace:§r Undead. Immune to poison, takes bonus damage from Smite; yet healing potions still mend her wounds, and harming potions hurt her as normal.$(br)§lAllegiance:§r Friendly. She never attacks players or villagers, and draws her blade against zombies, skeletons and other kin ruled by hunger. She and Drowned Girls will never harm one another.$(br)She is not purged on peaceful difficulty, and sunlight does not burn her. You may meet her in the open by day, or in darkness and night — about as often as ordinary zombies, just a little less often in daylight.

pages.title: A Waking Nightmare
pages.text: They are undead like zombies and skeletons, yet they loathe their own kind — loathe those walking corpses that surrendered to bloodlust and became pure monsters.$(br)They know full well that they, too, are monsters. Their living memories were preserved beneath the End's starlight, and that is the cruelest torment of all: they remember being human, and can never go back.$(br2)When you raise a weapon against her, she will not fight back. To her, death is not an end but a release — release from a body that is not hers, and from a self-loathing without end.
